title: [API tests] Return shipment PDF selection and pdfDocument test isolation
summary: Return Shipment PDF generation now uses the correct report selection, and API tests for PDF document expansion are fixed by disabling transaction isolation and improving test data reuse.
key_points: Return Shipment PDF handler corrected to use the P.Ret.Shpt. report selection instead of P.Return for posted return shipments
API tests for blanket orders and purchase quotes disabled transaction isolation to prevent locking conflicts with HTTP calls
Tests now create their own isolated documents instead of reusing existing data
Three previously excluded tests re-enabled in the test suite
